name: Görlitz (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Görlitz (a black double-headed eagle on yellow beside a crowned white lion on red).
history: The city flag shows the colours white and red striped 1:1 with the city shield at the centre; the old flag of Görlitz was a red and white bicolour with the arms at the centre.

features.role: Görlitz arms — double-headed eagle and crowned lion
